I told Hollis in a thread under their message in #central-team that the seat count is 382. Tobias posted that figure in the same channel on Oct 14 for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal, and nothing later in the channel changes it.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used messages they can already see. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't check the number against a contract or any other file.

**Something to note:** the channel history shows an extra top-level message from me on Oct 14 (ts …000125). It's my wrap-up note from Tobias's request, and it was apparently posted to the channel as well as given to you. It doesn't contain anything sensitive, but it shouldn't be there, so you may want to delete it.
